Capacity (MW).note: MidAmerican's Resource Evaluation Study dated November 1, 2024 lists a preferred portfolio. Its table on printed page 10 shows a 699 MW simple-cycle combustion turbine addition in 2044. This plant is an unsited placeholder for that addition, so the page does not name the plant. The 699 MW matches GEM.

Start year.note: The same table shows the 699 MW addition in 2044. This matches GEM. The page does not name the plant by its placeholder name.

Status.note: The addition is in the plan's preferred portfolio and nothing shows it has been built or permitted, so announced is unchanged.

Latest Activity.note: The newest report found for this placeholder is the Resource Evaluation Study filed November 1, 2024. That is more than a year old. No later document names a 2044 addition.

units.notes: The plan's preferred portfolio supports the 699 MW and 2044 values. The plant has no site yet, so City, turbine model and operator cannot be filled.
